name: codex-subscription-router-patcher
description: Build tooling for the independent Codex Subscription Router desktop app patch (macOS and Windows)

scripts.check: npm run check:go && npm run check:js && npm run check:win && npm run check:python && npm run check:shell
scripts.check:js: node --check ui/account-menu.js && node --check ui/thread-subscription.js && node --check ui/ui-test-bridge.cjs && node --test ui/account-menu.test.cjs
scripts.check:win: node --check scripts/win/exe-info.mjs && node --check scripts/win/set-asar-integrity.mjs && node --check scripts/win/pe.mjs && node --test "scripts/win/*.test.mjs"
scripts.check:python: python3 -m py_compile scripts/patch_app.py scripts/patch_app_windows.py scripts/check_release.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_*.py"
